name: @pipeworx/mcp-dati-it

tools.name: search_datasets
tools.description: Search the dati.gov.it catalogue of Italian public-administration open data (CKAN package_search). Returns matching datasets with titles/descriptions (mostly Italian). Query may be Italian or English; Italian matches far more.

query.description: Search terms, Italian or English. e.g. "trasporti", "salute", "bilancio", "health".

tools.name: dataset_details
tools.description: Full dataset record by id or slug (CKAN package_show), including its resources. Each resource carries a "url" you can fetch directly to download the data (CSV/JSON/etc.) — this portal has no datastore, so there is no row-level query API.

tools.name: list_organizations
tools.description: List the publishing organizations (ministries, regions, comuni, health agencies, etc.) on dati.gov.it (CKAN organization_list). Returns organization slugs; pass one to organization_details for the full record.

tools.name: organization_details
tools.description: Full record for one publishing organization by slug or id (CKAN organization_show): Italian display name, description, and dataset count. Get the slug from list_organizations or a dataset record.

id.description: Organization slug or id, e.g. "aci" or "agenzia-delle-dogane-e-dei-monopoli".

tools.name: list_groups
tools.description: List thematic groups/categories (Italian themes like Agricoltura, Salute, Trasporti) on dati.gov.it (CKAN group_list, with full fields).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-dati-it forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the dati-it pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
